description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer component, specifically testing the SetEos functionality in the Rialto client implementation. It defines a test class derived from a base test class, sets up and tears down the test environment, and includes two test cases to verify success and failure scenarios of the setEos method via mocked IPC calls.

classes.name: RialtoClientWebAudioPlayerSetEosTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the SetEos functionality of the WebAudioPlayer in the Rialto client, derived from WebAudioPlayerTestBase.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by calling the base class setup and creating a WebAudioPlayer instance.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by destroying the WebAudioPlayer instance and calling the base class teardown.
